before.description: Its value for the month before, when the books have it.

examples: the month end and the last three months

formula.description: How it is worked out, in words, as its tile shows on hover.
examples: Cash at month end ÷ the average net burn of the last three months of the financial year

source.description: Where it comes from: ledger (the balance service), entered (counts a person entered), ledger and entered, or subscription data (P2).

unit.description: What its value measures, which decides its decimals (RND-KPI).

version.description: The definition's version: a change of formula is a new one (FR-KPI-03).
